narrator.name: Reliability Ruth
narrator.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

inputs.hint: The fact is that something does not exist. Describe only how the work is done today without it, as observed events or numbers. No consequences, risks, costs or benefits.

output.content: I walked through the deployment pipeline this morning to check the latest model update. The retraining job did not start automatically as the schedule suggested. I found the process sitting idle in the queue. A colleague had to log in and click the start button manually to kick off the weekly cycle. This happens every week without fail. The system waits for a human to initiate the run. There is no automated trigger listening for new data or time based intervals. I watched the job begin only after that manual action. The logs show the timestamp of the human click, not a scheduled event. The pipeline remains static until someone intervenes directly.
output.reclassify_reason: The text describes a recurring operational issue and the current state of the pipeline without expressing a wish, refusal, or explicit acceptance of a trade-off.
